articles.title: UPI transactions touch record 18 billion volume mark in July 2026, NPCI data shows
articles.description: According to official data released by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transaction volumes reached a record 18 billion in July, reflecting growing retail digital payment penetration.

articles.title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana rooftop solar installations cross 25 lakh households
articles.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy announced that under the flagship PM Surya Ghar initiative, over 2.5 million households across India have successfully set up rooftop solar panels to receive up to 300 units of free power monthly.

articles.title: Gross GST revenues for July 2026 exceed ₹1.85 lakh crore, registering 11% YoY growth
articles.description: The Ministry of Finance reported robust economic momentum as gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections for July 2026 surpassed ₹1.85 lakh crore, driven by buoyant domestic transactions and enhanced compliance.

articles.title: Bureau of Indian Standards tightens online consumer review verification frameworks
articles.description: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) issued stricter compliance notices to e-commerce platforms to eliminate fake reviews and deceptive consumer ratings, citing consumer protection guidelines.

articles.title: Bengaluru becomes first Indian city to deploy 'Intelli-Flow' AI adaptive traffic system
articles.description: The Bengaluru Traffic Police and Municipal Corporation inaugurated 'Intelli-Flow', a comprehensive AI-driven traffic signaling network across all primary junctions to ease peak-hour urban vehicular congestion.

articles.title: DRDO and Indian Army conduct successful user trials of advanced Pinaka rocket system
articles.description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and the Indian Army successfully validated enhanced range and precision strike capabilities of the indigenous Pinaka Multi-Barrel Rocket Launcher at Pokhran firing range.

articles.title: Ministry of Power announces national energy storage battery reserve policy
articles.description: To stabilize the national grid with increasing solar and wind power feed, the Union Power Ministry introduced a viability gap funding framework for grid-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

articles.title: Health Ministry expands national Ayushman Bharat digital health registry integrations
articles.description: The National Health Authority (NHA) reported that over 65 crore ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) IDs have been created, linking digital diagnostic reports and prescriptions nationwide.

articles.title: Jharkhand rolls out 'Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana' for direct women assistance
articles.description: The Jharkhand state government commenced enrollment for the 'Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana', providing ₹1,000 monthly financial aid via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to eligible women aged 21 to 50 years.

articles.title: Kharif crop sowing area registers 3.5% expansion following healthy monsoon rains
articles.description: According to the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, total Kharif sown area crossed 900 lakh hectares, with significant acreages recorded in paddy, pulses, and oilseeds.

articles.title: Strategic Petroleum Reserves: India signs technical MoU with UAE for crude storage expansion
articles.description: Indian Strategic Petroleum Reserves Ltd (ISPRL) formalized an agreement to expand underground crude storage capacity in Padur, Karnataka, bolstering national long-term energy security.

articles.title: Union Ministry of Electronics releases draft blueprint for National Cyber Defence Shield
articles.description: MeitY published a policy paper aimed at protecting critical national infrastructure, including power grids, banking servers, and telecom hubs, from sophisticated AI-driven cyber threats.

articles.title: Bank of Baroda unveils 'Project Shikhar' to integrate GenAI in digital banking operations
articles.description: State-owned lender Bank of Baroda announced 'Project Shikhar', a large-scale technological overhaul aimed at integrating automated customer support, generative AI tools, and faster credit underwriting.

articles.title: Ministry of Home Affairs expands national 1930 cyber fraud helpline integration
articles.description: The Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting and Management System (CFCFRMS) integrated real-time API connectivity with all major scheduled commercial banks and digital payment wallets.

articles.title: India's defence exports maintain upward momentum, targeting ₹25,000 crore milestone
articles.description: Ministry of Defence data indicated that Indian defence equipment, including radar systems, ammunition, and patrol vessels, reached over 85 export partner nations in the ongoing fiscal year.

articles.title: Central government fast-tracks Green Energy Corridor Phase-II transmission lines
articles.description: To facilitate power evacuation from massive upcoming solar parks in Rajasthan and Gujarat, the Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS) network received expedited environment clearances.

articles.title: 6th BIMSTEC Summit concludes in Bangkok, focusing on Bay of Bengal connectivity pacts
articles.description: Leaders from BIMSTEC member states gathered in Thailand, signing agreements on maritime transport cooperation, security dialogues, and cross-border energy grid interconnections.

articles.title: Massive multi-agency rescue efforts continue in landslide-hit Wayanad district of Kerala
articles.description: Following devastating flash floods and landslides in hilly areas of Wayanad, teams from the NDRF, Indian Army, Air Force, and local volunteers mobilized extensive search and rescue operations.

articles.title: Centre enhances Model Skill Loan Scheme maximum ceiling to ₹7.5 lakh
articles.description: The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship raised the collateral-free loan limit under the Model Skill Loan Scheme to ₹7.5 lakh to help students pursue high-end vocational courses.

articles.title: India Semiconductor Mission receives three new advanced fab proposals
articles.description: The ISM evaluated new compound semiconductor and silicon carbide proposals worth over ₹20,000 crore from global consortiums seeking commercial setups in India.

articles.title: Sierra Leone takes over rotating Presidency of the United Nations Security Council for August
articles.description: Sierra Leone assumed the leadership of the UNSC for August 2026, setting the central agenda around African representation, conflict prevention, and counter-terrorism mandates.

articles.title: World observes 81st Hiroshima Day remembering atomic bombing victims
articles.description: Memorial ceremonies took place at the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park, emphasizing the urgent need for global nuclear disarmament and ratification of the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons.

articles.title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee begins three-day deliberations on interest rates
articles.description: The six-member MPC headed by the RBI Governor commenced its bi-monthly review meeting amid balanced domestic inflation trends and global central bank rate cut signals.

articles.title: National Water Awards announced for outstanding community rainwater harvesting projects
articles.description: The Department of Water Resources conferred awards on urban local bodies and rural panchayats showcasing exceptional groundwater rejuvenation through the Jal Shakti Abhiyan.

articles.title: India marks 12th National Handloom Day honoring weaver communities nationwide
articles.description: Events across the country celebrated National Handloom Day on August 7, commemorating the historic 1905 Swadeshi Movement and showcasing sustainable artisan textiles.

articles.title: Netherlands wins Olympic Men's Hockey Gold; Indian Men's team secures podium finish
articles.description: The Netherlands clinched the gold medal in men's hockey in a tense final, while the Indian team earned widespread praise for securing the bronze medal in the international tournament.

articles.title: Cabinet approves ₹3,000 crore capital outlay for green hydrogen production equipment
articles.description: Under the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) programme, the government sanctioned additional incentives for domestic electrolyser manufacturing units.

articles.title: Department of Agriculture accelerates integration of digital farmer IDs with state land registries
articles.description: Officials announced progress under the 'Digital Public Infrastructure for Agriculture', enabling simplified KYC for automated crop insurance claims and institutional credit.

articles.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.50%; enhances UPI tax payment limit to ₹5 lakh
articles.description: The Monetary Policy Committee voted to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%. In regulatory measures, the RBI enhanced the UPI per-transaction limit for tax payments from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh.

articles.title: India commemorates 84th anniversary of historic 1942 Quit India Movement
articles.description: Tributes were paid across the nation to freedom fighters of the Quit India Movement (August Kranti Diwas), launched by Mahatma Gandhi at Mumbai's Gowalia Tank Maidan in 1942.

articles.title: NHSRCL completes undersea tunnel excavation for Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train
articles.description: The National High Speed Rail Corporation achieved a major civil engineering milestone by completing the undersea tunneling work near Thane Creek for the high-speed rail corridor.

articles.title: Coal Ministry reports 9.2% rise in domestic thermal coal dispatch to power plants
articles.description: Domestic coal production and supply maintained adequate stock levels across all thermal power stations, preventing seasonal power deficits during the peak monsoon period.

articles.title: Indian Air Force commences Phase-1 of 'Exercise Tarang Shakti' with global partners
articles.description: The IAF launched 'Exercise Tarang Shakti' at Sulur, the largest multilateral air exercise hosted by India, featuring participation from over a dozen air forces to enhance tactical interoperability.

articles.title: World marks International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples with cultural events
articles.description: The UN observed Indigenous Peoples Day, highlighting the preservation of indigenous languages, tribal customary laws, and traditional knowledge in biodiversity conservation.

articles.title: Nagasaki Day observed globally, paying homage to victims of 1945 'Fat Man' atomic strike
articles.description: The Japanese city of Nagasaki held solemn peace memorial ceremonies, urging nuclear-armed states to halt modernization of warheads and reaffirm non-proliferation commitments.

articles.title: Bureau of Energy Efficiency notifies upgraded EV charging standards for public plazas
articles.description: BEE introduced uniform fast-charging connector norms and open-source payment integration guidelines for all high-capacity commercial EV charging stations.

articles.title: World Lion Day: Forest Department highlights steady growth in Gir's Asiatic Lion population
articles.description: On World Lion Day, Gujarat Forest authorities released census updates highlighting the sustained recovery and habitat expansion of the Asiatic Lion in the Greater Gir landscape.

articles.title: RBI Governor introduces 'Unified Lending Interface' (ULI) framework for frictionless credit
articles.description: Speaking at a financial technology conference, the RBI Governor announced the architecture for ULI, designed to standardize the exchange of land records, tax data, and banking history for rapid credit delivery.

articles.title: World Biofuel Day observed with focus on expanding 2G ethanol and compressed biogas plants
articles.description: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas marked World Biofuel Day, tracking progress toward the nationwide target of achieving 20% ethanol blending in petrol.

articles.title: Ministry of Ports announces major dredging project under Sagarmala to handle mega-vessels
articles.description: To accommodate ultra-large container ships, the government sanctioned deep-water capital dredging at key western and southern deep-sea ports.

articles.title: Former Union Health Secretary Preeti Sudan takes charge as UPSC Chairperson
articles.description: Senior administrator and former Union Health Secretary Preeti Sudan officially assumed office as the Chairperson of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) in New Delhi.

articles.title: Microsoft and Ministry of Skill Development ink pact to train 2 million students in GenAI
articles.description: A memorandum of understanding was signed between Microsoft India and the MSDE to deliver specialized courses in Generative AI tools and prompt engineering to students in Tier-2 and Tier-3 colleges.

articles.title: SEBI mandates BRSR Core reporting and assurance for top listed companies
articles.description: Markets regulator SEBI notified new ESG compliance rules, making third-party reasonable assurance mandatory for Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR Core) for top 250 listed firms.

articles.title: India-ASEAN Joint Committee reviews Free Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA)
articles.description: Delegations from India and ASEAN member countries held intensive talks in Jakarta to upgrade and rebalance terms of the trade pact to address tariff asymmetries.

articles.title: WHO Director-General declares escalating Mpox outbreak in Africa a global health emergency
articles.description: The World Health Organization declared the spreading outbreak of a new Mpox strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring African states a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

articles.title: World Elephant Day: Ministry of Environment releases comprehensive wild elephant census report
articles.description: On World Elephant Day, wildlife census data confirmed that Karnataka, Assam, and Kerala continue to host the country's highest wild elephant populations, with enhanced corridor mapping underway.

articles.title: International Youth Day observed with global focus on digital pathways for sustainable development
articles.description: United Nations events marked International Youth Day under the theme 'From Clicks to Progress: Youth Digital Pathways for Sustainable Development', spotlighting youth innovators in AI and climate tech.

articles.title: National Institute of Ocean Technology prepares deep-sea submersible 'Matsya 6000' for wet trials
articles.description: As part of the Deep Ocean Mission (Samudrayaan), scientists completed pressure hull acoustic inspections for the manned submersible Matsya 6000 ahead of deep harbour dive tests.

articles.title: India adds new designated wetlands to Ramsar list, taking national tally to 95 sites
articles.description: On the eve of Independence Day celebrations, the Ministry of Environment announced that international recognition was granted to additional ecologically critical wetlands across the country.

articles.title: ISRO performs successful static fire test of propulsion systems for SPADEX mission
articles.description: ISRO achieved a key engineering milestone by successfully validating the thruster systems for its Space Docking Experiment (SPADEX), vital for autonomous orbital rendezvous and the planned Indian Space Station.

articles.title: World Organ Donation Day highlights Tamil Nadu's leading deceased donor registry model
articles.description: Health authorities celebrated World Organ Donation Day by recognizing TRANSTAN's cadaver transplantation network, which has sustained the highest per-capita organ retrieval rate in India.

articles.title: TRAI issues quality-of-service regulations for mobile telecom network latency and 5G stability
articles.description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) announced tightened QoS benchmarks, introducing financial disincentives for frequent urban call drops and jitter in high-speed 5G networks.

articles.title: Nation observes Partition Horrors Remembrance Day paying tribute to victims of 1947 partition
articles.description: Exhibitions and commemorative events were organized nationwide on 'Vibhajan Vibhishika Smriti Diwas' to remember the struggles, trauma, and sacrifices of millions displaced during the 1947 partition.

articles.title: Ministry of Home Affairs launches 'e-Sakshya' portal for digital criminal evidence collection
articles.description: Home Minister launched the 'e-Sakshya' digital evidence repository to help police departments record, geocode, and securely transmit forensic video and search recordings under the new BNS criminal laws.

articles.title: SEBI releases consultation paper proposing measures to curb speculative retail losses in Index F&O
articles.description: Markets regulator SEBI unveiled structural proposals, including increased lot sizes, rationalized weekly option expiries, and upfront premium collection, to curb high-risk speculative derivative trading.

articles.title: Uttarakhand finalizes operational rules for Uniform Civil Code implementation
articles.description: The Uttarakhand state administration announced the completion of portal frameworks and civil registry guidelines required to enforce its landmark Uniform Civil Code (UCC) legislation.

articles.title: India celebrates 80th Independence Day; PM Modi addresses the nation from Red Fort ramparts
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the country on the 80th Independence Day, outlining pillars for 'Viksit Bharat by 2047', self-reliance in semiconductors, deep-tech research, and sustainable energy.

articles.title: President approves 103 Gallantry awards to Armed Forces and Central Armed Police personnel
articles.description: President Droupadi Murmu approved Kirti Chakras, Shaurya Chakras, and Sena Medals for military personnel in recognition of exceptional acts of courage and sacrifice during counter-terror operations.

articles.title: 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign sees massive public participation across all states and UTs
articles.description: Citizens and institutions hoisted the national flag across millions of homes, boats, border posts, and public monuments under the nationwide campaign spearheaded by the Ministry of Culture.

articles.title: Indigenous Tejas Mk-1A and Advanced Light Helicopters perform ceremonial flypast over Delhi
articles.description: The Indian Air Force conducted an aerial display featuring indigenous Tejas fighter aircraft, Prachand combat helicopters, and transport planes over the National War Memorial and Red Fort.

articles.title: T. V. Somanathan appointed Cabinet Secretary of India, succeeding Rajiv Gauba
articles.description: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet officially designated senior IAS officer and former Finance Secretary Dr. T. V. Somanathan as the new Cabinet Secretary of India for a two-year tenure.

articles.title: ISRO's SSLV-D3 successfully injects EOS-08 Earth Observation Satellite into precise orbit
articles.description: In its third and final developmental flight from Sriharikota, ISRO's Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV-D3) placed the EOS-08 satellite and SR-0 DEMOSAT payload into planned circular low Earth orbits.

articles.title: Government makes BIS standard IS 19000:2022 mandatory for all e-commerce consumer reviews
articles.description: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs notified the mandatory enforcement of IS 19000 standards to ensure all commercial e-commerce platforms verify reviewer identities and penalize undisclosed paid endorsements.

articles.title: Ministry of Heavy Industries previews Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027 roadmap
articles.description: Automotive bodies, battery manufacturers, and policymakers convened in New Delhi to outline pavilions for hydrogen vehicles, battery swap ecosystems, and software-defined vehicles for the upcoming expo.

articles.title: India-Japan hold 3rd '2+2' Ministerial Dialogue in New Delhi to deepen defence cooperation
articles.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met their Japanese counterparts, agreeing to expand joint naval exercises, co-develop unmanned systems, and protect undersea telecom cables.

articles.title: Carlos Alcaraz clinches Men's Singles title at 2026 Cincinnati Masters tournament
articles.description: Spanish tennis star Carlos Alcaraz defeated Jannik Sinner in a thrilling three-set final at the Cincinnati Open, sealing his form ahead of the final Grand Slam of the year at Flushing Meadows.

articles.title: Direct tax collections grow 16.5% to ₹6.95 lakh crore till mid-August, CBDT data confirms
articles.description: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) reported buoyant corporate and personal income tax inflows, reflecting steady corporate earnings and broadened digital tax compliance.

articles.title: Ministry of Power issues strict dynamic line rating guidelines to prevent grid bottlenecks
articles.description: The Central Electricity Authority mandated real-time temperature and wind sensor installations on high-voltage interstate transmission corridors to maximize power carrying capacity without overloading.

articles.title: RailTel Corporation of India granted 'Navratna' CPSE status by Department of Public Enterprises
articles.description: The Ministry of Finance elevated telecom infrastructure PSU RailTel to 'Navratna' status, granting its board enhanced financial autonomy to invest in large domestic broadband and overseas cloud projects.

articles.title: National Film Awards announced: Best feature films and artists honored across languages
articles.description: The Directorate of Film Festivals under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting announced winners of the National Film Awards, honoring creative excellence in feature films and documentaries.

articles.title: Indian wrestler Vinesh Phogat officially elected to United World Wrestling Athletes' Commission
articles.description: United World Wrestling (UWW) announced the election of prominent Indian wrestler Vinesh Phogat to its global Athletes' Commission, representing active athletes' interests in governance.

articles.title: Indian space-tech startup ecosystem secures record $150M venture funding in 2026
articles.description: IN-SPACe industry report highlighted that Indian private space companies building low-Earth launch vehicles, satellite constellations, and optical payloads saw record venture capital deployment.

articles.title: World Humanitarian Day and World Photography Day observed across the globe on August 19
articles.description: The UN commemorated World Humanitarian Day under the hashtag #ActForHumanity to honor aid workers facing extreme risks, while photographic institutions celebrated the history and craft of visual documentation.

articles.title: World Sanskrit Day (Vishwa Samskrita Dinam) celebrated on Shravana Purnima
articles.description: Universities and cultural bodies organized national conferences and recitations to promote Sanskrit literature, classical research, and its integration into natural language processing applications.

articles.title: NHAI rolls out nationwide 'Eco-Corridor' initiative planting 1 crore native trees
articles.description: The National Highways Authority of India commenced a coordinated roadside plantation drive across all newly completed expressways to reduce vehicular emissions and soil erosion along rights of way.

articles.title: India-Africa Defence Partnership seminar kicks off in Pune with 25 African delegations
articles.description: Military commanders and defence procurement delegates from 25 African nations convened in Pune to explore indigenous training solutions, co-production, and coastal security equipment.

articles.title: India observes Sadbhavana Diwas commemorating birth anniversary of Rajiv Gandhi
articles.description: Sadbhavana Diwas (National Harmony Day) was observed across government offices and educational institutions, where people took pledges to shun violence and foster emotional integration across communities.

articles.title: Akshay Urja Diwas: Renewable Energy Ministry spotlights decentralized solar growth
articles.description: On National Renewable Energy Day, MNRE showcased achievements under PM-KUSUM and rooftop solar missions, emphasizing rural employment generation through clean energy transition.

articles.title: India and Uzbekistan sign Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) to boost mutual investments
articles.description: Finance Ministry representatives signed a comprehensive Bilateral Investment Treaty with Uzbekistan in Tashkent to provide reciprocal investment protection and dispute settlement mechanisms.

articles.title: National Clean Air Programme review shows particulate matter reduction in 85 non-attainment cities
articles.description: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) air quality audit highlighted measurable improvements in PM10 and PM2.5 concentrations in urban centers, backed by localized dust suppression and EV transit adoption.

articles.title: RBI's Unified Lending Interface (ULI) enters final testing phase for nationwide MSME rollout
articles.description: The Reserve Bank of India announced that the 'Unified Lending Interface' (ULI), designed to ensure frictionless credit delivery to MSMEs and rural borrowers, has entered its final sandbox testing phase before its official nationwide launch.

articles.title: Indian Navy successfully conducts trials of indigenous advanced heavyweight torpedoes
articles.description: In a major boost to 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' in defence, the Indian Navy successfully test-fired an upgraded indigenous heavyweight torpedo from a Kalvari-class submarine, demonstrating enhanced target tracking and striking capabilities.

articles.title: Government hikes Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Rabi crops for 2026-27 season
articles.description: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved a substantial hike in the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for all mandated Rabi crops, with wheat seeing an increase of ₹160 per quintal to support farmers ahead of the sowing season.

articles.title: Quad Foreign Ministers' meeting held in Tokyo focuses on Indo-Pacific maritime security
articles.description: Foreign Ministers of India, US, Japan, and Australia convened in Tokyo to discuss actionable strategies for maritime domain awareness, cybersecurity, and resilient supply chains across the Indo-Pacific region amid rising geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: India and Japan sign bilateral pact to develop resilient semiconductor supply chains
articles.description: India and Japan inked a memorandum of cooperation to jointly develop semiconductor design, manufacturing, and equipment research, aiming to reduce dependence on East Asian supply hubs.

articles.title: ISRO successfully tests scramjet engine for advanced Reusable Launch Vehicle (RLV)
articles.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) achieved a critical milestone by successfully conducting a flight test of its Air-Breathing Propulsion system (Scramjet), paving the way for cost-effective two-stage-to-orbit reusable launch vehicles.

articles.title: SEBI tightens algorithmic trading regulations to protect retail investors
articles.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) issued new, stringent guidelines for Application Programming Interface (API) based algorithmic trading, mandating rigorous broker-level approvals to curb unchecked speculation and system crashes.

articles.title: NITI Aayog releases 'Vision 2035' document for sustainable urban mobility
articles.description: NITI Aayog unveiled a comprehensive roadmap aiming to electrify 70% of public transport and commercial fleets by 2035, integrating smart-grid charging infrastructure across 100 Indian tier-1 and tier-2 cities.

articles.title: India celebrates 3rd National Space Day commemorating Chandrayaan-3 landing
articles.description: Across the country, the 3rd National Space Day was celebrated with ISRO organizing massive outreach programs in schools. The day marks the historic soft landing of the Vikram lander on the lunar south pole in 2023.

articles.title: Defence Ministry clears procurement of 114 Multi-Role Fighter Aircraft (MRFA)
articles.description: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for the long-pending procurement of 114 MRFA jets for the Indian Air Force under the Strategic Partnership model.

articles.title: India surpasses 200 GW milestone in installed non-fossil fuel energy capacity
articles.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy officially announced that India's total installed electricity generation capacity from non-fossil sources (solar, wind, hydro, and nuclear) has crossed the historic 200 GW mark.

articles.title: Ministry of Education announces rollout of Digital University framework under NEP
articles.description: In line with the National Education Policy 2020, the government launched the operational framework for the National Digital University, offering flexible, credit-based degree programs in regional languages.

articles.title: RBI Governor flags AI-driven financial frauds, urges banks to upgrade cybersecurity
articles.description: During a summit in Mumbai, the RBI Governor warned against the rising threat of deepfake and AI-generated voice cloning frauds, directing all scheduled commercial banks to overhaul their biometric security protocols.

articles.title: Cabinet approves expanding Ayushman Bharat health cover to all senior citizens above 70
articles.description: The Union Cabinet approved a major extension of the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY), providing free health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh to all citizens aged 70 and above, irrespective of income.

articles.title: India wins major arbitration case at WTO regarding agricultural subsidies
articles.description: India successfully defended its public stockholding program for food security at the World Trade Organization, with an arbitration panel ruling that its rice subsidies do not violate global trade distortion thresholds.

articles.title: Supreme Court mandates strict environmental clearances for Himalayan infrastructure
articles.description: In a landmark verdict addressing recurrent landslides and floods, the Supreme Court ordered that all road, rail, and hydro projects in the Himalayan states must undergo a carrying-capacity assessment before approval.

articles.title: Central government rolls out ‘One Nation, One Student ID’ (APAAR) mandatorily
articles.description: The Ministry of Education mandated the generation of the Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry (APAAR) ID for all university students to streamline credit transfers, scholarship disbursements, and degree verification.

articles.title: DRDO test-fires upgraded Nirbhay cruise missile with indigenous propulsion
articles.description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully tested a deeply upgraded variant of the Nirbhay sub-sonic cruise missile, now powered entirely by the indigenous Manik turbofan engine.

articles.title: India formally Submits Letter of Intent for hosting the 2036 Olympic Games
articles.description: The Indian Olympic Association (IOA), backed by the Sports Ministry, officially submitted its 'Letter of Intent' to the International Olympic Committee (IOC) to host the 2036 Summer Olympics, proposing Ahmedabad as the anchor city.

articles.title: First indigenous commercial hydrogen fuel cell bus begins operations in Pune
articles.description: Developed collaboratively by CSIR and private partners, India's first fully indigenous hydrogen fuel cell commercial bus began passenger operations in Pune, marking a milestone in zero-emission transport.

articles.title: India assumes presidency of the Global Artificial Intelligence Partnership (GPAI)
articles.description: For the second consecutive term, India assumed the presidency of the GPAI, outlining a vision to create an open-source global regulatory framework for safe, ethical, and transparent AI development.

articles.title: GST Council announces revised tax slabs, merging 12% and 18% into a single 15% tier
articles.description: In a massive tax overhaul, the GST Council agreed to streamline the taxation structure by merging the 12% and 18% slabs into a single 15% slab, aiming to reduce classification disputes and compliance burdens.

articles.title: Health Ministry issues high alert following a new Mpox strain outbreak
articles.description: Following WHO's declaration of a global health emergency, the Union Health Ministry issued enhanced surveillance protocols at all international airports and established dedicated isolation nodes in major hospitals.

articles.title: Indian Railways launches 'Vande Sleeper' dedicated fleet for overnight intercity travel
articles.description: The Minister of Railways flagged off the inaugural commercial run of the 'Vande Sleeper' trainset between Delhi and Mumbai, promising superior ride comfort, speed, and safety features for overnight passengers.

articles.title: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy launches National Green Hydrogen Pipeline project
articles.description: The Centre unveiled a ₹15,000 crore infrastructure plan to build dedicated pipeline networks connecting Green Hydrogen production hubs in Gujarat and Rajasthan to major industrial clusters and ports.

articles.title: BIMSTEC nations sign a historic free trade agreement during the Bangkok summit
articles.description: The seven member states of BIMSTEC signed a comprehensive Free Trade Agreement in Bangkok, aimed at reducing tariffs on 70% of traded goods and enhancing maritime connectivity across the Bay of Bengal.

articles.title: ISRO officially announces Gaganyaan's first crewed flight target for late 2026
articles.description: ISRO Chairman confirmed that following the successful completion of uncrewed test flights and humanoid data validation, the maiden human spaceflight mission (H1) is scheduled for the final quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Supreme Court upholds the constitutionality of the Digital Personal Data Protection rules
articles.description: A constitutional bench of the Supreme Court dismissed petitions challenging the DPDP Act rules, ruling that the exemptions granted to state instrumentalities for national security are reasonable and legally sound.

articles.title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana marks 12 years with total deposit balances crossing ₹3.5 Lakh Crore
articles.description: Celebrating the 12th anniversary of the financial inclusion scheme, the Finance Ministry revealed that over 55 crore PMJDY accounts have been opened to date, with total deposits crossing an unprecedented ₹3.5 lakh crore.

articles.title: India overtakes Japan to firmly establish itself as the world’s third-largest auto market
articles.description: Latest industry data from OICA confirmed that India's domestic automobile sales have widened the gap over Japan, cementing India's position as the third-largest auto market globally, driven by massive EV adoption.

articles.title: World Bank approves $1.5 billion loan to support India’s low-carbon agriculture transition
articles.description: The World Bank's Board of Executive Directors approved a significant $1.5 billion financing package to help India promote climate-resilient agriculture, reduce methane emissions, and boost rural incomes.

articles.title: National Medical Commission introduces strict regulations to curb unethical telemedicine
articles.description: To prevent misdiagnosis and the over-prescription of antibiotics, the NMC released updated telemedicine guidelines, mandating video consultations for first-time diagnoses and strictly prohibiting the online sale of Schedule H drugs.

articles.title: National Sports Awards: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna conferred on National Sports Day
articles.description: President Droupadi Murmu presented the National Sports Awards at Rashtrapati Bhavan, honoring India's top athletes, coaches, and sporting institutions for their exceptional performances in global arenas.

articles.title: RBI permits foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) to directly trade in domestic corporate bonds
articles.description: In a move to deepen the corporate bond market, the RBI allowed FPIs to participate directly in corporate bond trading on domestic exchanges without routing transactions through local brokers.

articles.title: Centre announces a comprehensive ₹50,000 crore package for flood mitigation in NE states
articles.description: Following devastating monsoons, the Home Ministry announced a massive infrastructure package aimed at building modern embankments, dredging the Brahmaputra, and setting up advanced early warning systems in the Northeast.

articles.title: India and France finalize joint development of a nuclear attack submarine
articles.description: Deepening their strategic partnership, India and France signed a definitive agreement to co-design and manufacture a new class of nuclear-powered attack submarines (SSN) under the 'Make in India' initiative.

articles.title: NSO data reveals India's Q1 GDP growth at robust 7.8% driven by manufacturing
articles.description: The National Statistical Office (NSO) reported that the Indian economy grew by 7.8% in the April-June quarter of FY 2026-27, outperforming expectations on the back of a strong resurgence in capital goods and manufacturing.

articles.title: Ministry of MSME launches 'Udyam 2.0' portal integrating credit and compliance solutions
articles.description: To drastically improve the ease of doing business, the MSME Ministry launched 'Udyam 2.0', a unified digital portal where registered enterprises can file taxes, apply for collateral-free loans, and track government tenders.

articles.title: PM Modi departs for the BRICS 2026 Summit, focus expected on local currency trade
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi departed for the BRICS Summit, where member nations are expected to finalize a framework for cross-border trade settlements in national currencies to bypass reliance on the US Dollar.

articles.title: ISRO's Aditya-L1 captures unprecedented data on early-stage solar coronal mass ejections
articles.description: Scientists published new findings based on data from the Aditya-L1 solar observatory, revealing early magnetic warning signs that precede violent solar flares, crucial for protecting global satellite networks.
